source.label: mtgo.com decklists: Vintage Eternal Weekend: Workshop

notes.text: ecobaronen (Doomsday, seed 3) won the Top 8 on Magic Online, beating StaticGripped (David Lance) in the final, but was disqualified without prizes afterwards for agreeing a prize split in round 10. magic.gg's results table lists only seven players, StaticGripped 1st to mattb 7th, with everyone below ecobaronen moved up one place; placings here follow that table. ecobaronen's list is left out because the official results give him no place in the Top 8; it is on mtgo.com, which (like mtgtop8) still ranks him 1st and StaticGripped 2nd.
Seven lists, so the file is marked partial: the Top 8 as officially recorded has seven players, not because lists are missing.
magic.gg spells Antarctica "Antartica"; mtgtop8 calls StaticGripped's deck MUD.
Started 2020-10-25 08:05 PDT with ten Swiss rounds; the Top 8 was played that evening Pacific time (early 2020-10-26 UTC).
Magic Online lists each printing of a card on its own line; copies of the same card are added together here.
Seeds are the seeding shown in mtgo.com's Top 8 bracket.

Archetype names are MTGGoldfish's, for consistency across events. Kept from the earlier source where Goldfish names only colours or lists no deck: StaticGripped (Goldfish: 'Colorless'); Bosh N Roll (Goldfish: 'URG'); Antarctica (Goldfish: 'Colorless'); Aylett (Goldfish: 'UBRG').
Played on Magic Online as StaticGripped, the name every source gives. Identified as David Lance by Rajah James, his Team Serious teammate.
